shared_elements: fan of parallel incised lines rendering feathers or wing
circular disc set beside a creature
rectangular recessed panel / rectilinear framed element
horizontal band-like division of the field
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief creatures whose plumage or fur is indicated by fans of parallel incisions, and each includes a plain circular disc placed next to a creature plus a rectilinear framed/recessed element, which is a moderately specific coincidence. However, B presents an ordered multi-register composition with a repeated row of arched motifs, a fringed band, quadrupeds, a snake-like form and a large wing-spread bird, whereas A shows only one or two large, ambiguous, unregistered forms, so the overall scenes and their internal relationships do not correspond.
